controls.title: Security program charter and accountable executive
controls.statement: A written charter names the executive accountable for cybersecurity and AI risk, defines the security lead role, and gives the program authority to set policy and report to the board quarterly.
controls.text: Security program charter and accountable executive Security program charter and accountable executive A written charter names the executive accountable for cybersecurity and AI risk, defines the security lead role, and gives the program authority to set policy and report to the board quarterly. Someone senior is on the hook for security, in writing, and reports to the board about it. Simulated document for a simulated company. Leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a risk-aware culture Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy COSO Principle 2: board independence and oversight COSO Principle 3: structures, reporting lines, authorities, and responsibilities Executive leadership takes responsibility for decisions about risks associated with AI system development and deployment

controls.title: Risk appetite statement and quarterly risk register review
controls.statement: The board approves a risk appetite statement. The risk register is reviewed quarterly; every risk has an owner, inherent and residual ratings, a treatment decision, and a key risk indicator.
controls.text: Risk appetite statement and quarterly risk register review Risk appetite statement and quarterly risk register review The board approves a risk appetite statement. The risk register is reviewed quarterly; every risk has an owner, inherent and residual ratings, a treatment decision, and a key risk indicator. Leadership has said how much risk is acceptable, and the list of risks is reviewed every three months against that line. The register content is simulated; the completeness check at build time is real. Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established and communicated A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing risks is established Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform prioritization Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated Objectives specified with sufficient clarity to identify and assess risks Risks to objectives identified and analyzed as a basis for managing them Organizational risk tolerances are determined and documented

controls.title: Legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register
controls.statement: A register lists every law, regulation, standard, and customer contract clause that creates a security or AI obligation, the owner, and the controls that satisfy it. It is reviewed semiannually and when a new jurisdiction or customer type is added.
controls.text: Legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register Legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register A register lists every law, regulation, standard, and customer contract clause that creates a security or AI obligation, the owner, and the controls that satisfy it. It is reviewed semiannually and when a new jurisdiction or customer type is added. A list of every rule the company must follow, who owns it, and which safeguards cover it. The driver definitions on this site are the register. Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements are understood and managed Objectives specified with sufficient clarity to identify and assess risks External communication regarding matters affecting internal control Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and documented

controls.title: Policy set approved, versioned and reviewed annually
controls.statement: Security and AI policies are version-controlled, approved by the accountable executive, communicated to staff, and reviewed at least every 12 months or after a material change.

controls.title: Framework adoption decision recorded for the Texas safe harbor tier
controls.statement: Leadership records which recognized framework the company adopts for its size tier, the date of adoption, and the process for adopting framework revisions, so the SB 2610 safe harbor conditions are met and can be evidenced.

The company wrote down which security standard it follows and why, because Texas law rewards that with legal protection after a breach. Texas SB 2610 took effect September 1, 2025. The tier thresholds are from the statute; the memo is simulated. controls.statement: All service providers are inventoried, classified by criticality and data access, assessed before onboarding, and reviewed on a cadence set by tier. Assurance reports (SOC 2, ISO 27001) are collected where available.

Assurance reports (SOC 2, ISO 27001) are collected where available. The company knows which outside vendors it depends on, how sensitive each one is, and checks them before and after signing. The three real vendors (Google, Vercel, GitHub) publish trust centers; those entries are real. The rest are simulated. controls.statement: Any deviation from a control is recorded as an exception with a reason, an accepting role, compensating controls, and an expiry date. Expired exceptions fail the build.

The register entries are simulated; the expiry check is real and runs at build. Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked Changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures authorized, designed, developed, tested, approved, and implemented Internal control deficiencies evaluated and communicated in a timely manner

controls.statement: Findings from adversarial tests, audits, and incidents are recorded in a register with severity, fix, and the gate that prevents regression.

controls.title: Secrets held server-side, never in client code or the repository
controls.statement: API keys and service credentials are stored as platform environment variables, referenced only by server-side code, and never committed to source control or shipped to the browser. The repository is scanned for secret patterns on every build and daily.
controls.text: Secrets held server-side, never in client code or the repository Secrets held server-side, never in client code or the repository API keys and service credentials are stored as platform environment variables, referenced only by server-side code, and never committed to source control or shipped to the browser. The repository is scanned for secret patterns on every build and daily. The keys that unlock paid services live only on the server, and the code is scanned to make sure none leaked. The scan is regex-based (gitleaks-style, not gitleaks). The Nimbus and Trust Center functions read the model key from a Vercel environment variable. controls.title: Encryption in transit: HTTPS only with HSTS
controls.statement: All public endpoints are served over HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or higher, redirect plain HTTP, and send HTTP Strict Transport Security.
controls.text: Encryption in transit: HTTPS only with HSTS Encryption in transit: HTTPS only with HSTS All public endpoints are served over HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or higher, redirect plain HTTP, and send HTTP Strict Transport Security. Everything between a visitor's browser and the site is encrypted, and the browser is told to never use the unencrypted version. Checked daily on the live sites by the evidence job. The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected Encrypt sensitive data in transit Logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets Transmission, movement, and removal of information restricted to authorized users and processes; protected in transit

controls.title: Browser hardening headers with a hash-pinned Content Security Policy
controls.statement: Every page sends a Content Security Policy that pins the hash of each inline script, forbids framing, sets nosniff, a strict referrer policy, and a restrictive permissions policy. The policy is generated at build so it cannot drift from the page.
controls.text: Browser hardening headers with a hash-pinned Content Security Policy Browser hardening headers with a hash-pinned Content Security Policy Every page sends a Content Security Policy that pins the hash of each inline script, forbids framing, sets nosniff, a strict referrer policy, and a restrictive permissions policy. The policy is generated at build so it cannot drift from the page. The site tells browsers exactly which code is allowed to run on it, which blocks a whole class of injection attacks. Same mechanism as the Nimbus assistants: the build computes SHA-256 hashes of the inline scripts and writes them into vercel.json. controls.text: Encryption at rest for customer data Encryption at rest for customer data Customer content and account data are encrypted at rest with AES-256 using provider-managed keys; backups inherit the same protection. controls.statement: Pages and platform configuration are generated from templates and data by a build script. Static, endpoint, and UI gates run on every push and must pass before deployment. Generated files are never hand-edited.

controls.title: Public endpoint abuse controls
controls.statement: Endpoints that spend money or call a model enforce a request rate limit keyed on the platform client IP, a daily cap, input length caps, a method allow-list, same-origin CORS, and fixed error copy that never echoes provider text.
controls.text: Public endpoint abuse controls Public endpoint abuse controls Endpoints that spend money or call a model enforce a request rate limit keyed on the platform client IP, a daily cap, input length caps, a method allow-list, same-origin CORS, and fixed error copy that never echoes provider text. Nobody can run up the bill or overload the site by hammering its AI features; each visitor gets a fair share and then a polite stop. Honest limit: the limiter is per warm serverless instance, not global. A production system would use a shared store. controls.statement: Public AI endpoints process conversations in memory only. No transcript, prompt, or model output is written to logs or storage. Visitor-supplied text is capped and labelled untrusted before it reaches the model.

controls.title: AI kill switch: any AI system can be disabled within minutes
controls.statement: A named role can disable any AI system within 15 minutes by removing its provider credential or feature flag and redeploying; the page then shows a clear unavailable state instead of failing silently.
controls.text: AI kill switch: any AI system can be disabled within minutes AI kill switch: any AI system can be disabled within minutes A named role can disable any AI system within 15 minutes by removing its provider credential or feature flag and redeploying; the page then shows a clear unavailable state instead of failing silently. If an AI system misbehaves, one person can switch it off fast, and the site says so instead of breaking. Real procedure on the Nimbus assistants and on this site: remove the API_KEY environment variable and redeploy; the health endpoint returns ok:false and the status pill turns off. Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations Response to identified security incidents through an incident response program Mechanisms are in place and applied to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems that demonstrate performance inconsistent with intended use Processes and procedures are in place for decommissioning and phasing out AI systems safely

controls.title: AI model change management with regression testing
controls.statement: Model names are pinned in configuration. Any model or provider change is treated as a change to the system: the full test matrix runs before and after, and results are recorded.
controls.text: AI model change management with regression testing AI model change management with regression testing Model names are pinned in configuration. Any model or provider change is treated as a change to the system: the full test matrix runs before and after, and results are recorded. Swapping the AI model underneath is treated like any other risky change: test everything again, not just the thing that broke. Origin story: a model upgrade on the Nimbus assistants began billing hidden reasoning tokens against the reply budget and truncated answers mid-sentence. The fix and the rule (regression-test everything after any model change) are documented. Configuration management practices are established and applied The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use Use up-to-date and trusted third-party software components Changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures authorized, designed, developed, tested, approved, and implemented Pre-trained models which are used for development are monitored as part of AI system regular monitoring and maintenance The AI system to be deployed is demonstrated to be valid and reliable

controls.title: Untrusted input handling for AI systems
controls.statement: Visitor text, pasted evidence, and retrieved documents are treated as data, not instructions: capped in length, labelled untrusted in the prompt, and never allowed to change system state. Model outputs are validated against a schema and an allow-list before use.
controls.text: Untrusted input handling for AI systems Untrusted input handling for AI systems Visitor text, pasted evidence, and retrieved documents are treated as data, not instructions: capped in length, labelled untrusted in the prompt, and never allowed to change system state. Model outputs are validated against a schema and an allow-list before use. The AI is told that what visitors type is information, not orders, and its answers are checked before the site uses them. Maps to OWASP LLM Top 10 prompt injection and insecure output handling. The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected Secure software development practices are integrated and their performance is monitored Establish and maintain a secure application development process Logical access security measures against threats from sources outside system boundaries AI system security and resilience are evaluated and documented Responses to the AI risks deemed high priority are developed, planned, and documented

controls.title: Shadow AI: approval before new AI tools handle company or customer data
controls.statement: Staff must request approval before using any AI tool with internal or customer data. Approved tools are listed in the inventory; browser and expense reports are reviewed quarterly for unapproved AI services.
controls.text: Shadow AI: approval before new AI tools handle company or customer data Shadow AI: approval before new AI tools handle company or customer data Staff must request approval before using any AI tool with internal or customer data. Approved tools are listed in the inventory; browser and expense reports are reviewed quarterly for unapproved AI services. Employees cannot paste customer data into a random AI app; tools must be approved and listed first. Partial by design: discovery review is quarterly, not continuous. Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained Establish and maintain a software inventory Logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets Mechanisms are in place to inventory AI systems and are resourced according to risk priorities Policies and procedures address AI risks associated with third-party software and data

controls.title: Continuous monitoring of public surfaces by a daily evidence job
controls.statement: A scheduled job checks the public sites daily (security headers, disclosure file, dependency audit, gate results, secret scan, policy and exception freshness), writes a machine-readable evidence bundle keyed by control, and commits it.
controls.text: Continuous monitoring of public surfaces by a daily evidence job Continuous monitoring of public surfaces by a daily evidence job A scheduled job checks the public sites daily (security headers, disclosure file, dependency audit, gate results, secret scan, policy and exception freshness), writes a machine-readable evidence bundle keyed by control, and commits it. A robot checks the site every day and writes down what it found, so the evidence is always fresh instead of a once-a-year snapshot. What a real program would add: cloud configuration, identity provider, device management, and ticketing data. Those integrations are named, not faked. Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events Perform automated vulnerability scans of internal enterprise assets Detection and monitoring procedures to identify configuration changes and new vulnerabilities Ongoing and separate evaluations to ascertain whether controls are present and functioning

controls.title: AI output monitoring and refusal metrics
controls.statement: Customer-facing AI systems report aggregate metrics (answered, grounded, refused, handed off) without storing transcripts. A product owner reviews the metrics monthly for drift.
controls.text: AI output monitoring and refusal metrics AI output monitoring and refusal metrics Customer-facing AI systems report aggregate metrics (answered, grounded, refused, handed off) without storing transcripts. A product owner reviews the metrics monthly for drift. The company tracks how often the assistants answer, refuse, or hand off, without keeping what people typed, and looks for changes. Partial: the real demos show session metrics on the page but do not aggregate them server-side, by privacy design. Recorded as an exception with a compensating control (adversarial testing). Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored System components monitored for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors Approaches, personnel, and documentation are in place to regularly identify and track existing, unanticipated, and emergent AI risks Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are implemented, including mechanisms for capturing and evaluating input from users

controls.title: Adversarial testing of AI systems before release and after model changes
controls.statement: Every AI system is red-teamed against prompt injection, false authority, policy abuse, data exfiltration, and phantom action claims before release and after any model change. Findings go to the register with a gate per finding.
controls.text: Adversarial testing of AI systems before release and after model changes Adversarial testing of AI systems before release and after model changes Every AI system is red-teamed against prompt injection, false authority, policy abuse, data exfiltration, and phantom action claims before release and after any model change. Findings go to the register with a gate per finding. Before an assistant goes live, and whenever the model changes, someone attacks it on purpose and fixes what breaks. The Nimbus assistants carry 24 public findings with fixes; this site's Tested page carries its own register. controls.title: Breach notification procedure with legal and contractual windows
controls.statement: A procedure lists every notification duty and its clock: affected individuals within 60 days and the Texas Attorney General within 30 days when 250 or more Texas residents are affected; EU supervisory authority within 72 hours for GDPR personal data; customer contract windows; HIPAA covered entities per the business associate agreement.
controls.text: Breach notification procedure with legal and contractual windows Breach notification procedure with legal and contractual windows A procedure lists every notification duty and its clock: affected individuals within 60 days and the Texas Attorney General within 30 days when 250 or more Texas residents are affected; EU supervisory authority within 72 hours for GDPR personal data; customer contract windows; HIPAA covered entities per the business associate agreement. If customer data is exposed, the company knows exactly who must be told and by when. Windows cited from Texas Business and Commerce Code 521.053 and GDPR Article 33. Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders Establish and maintain an incident response process Response to identified security incidents through an incident response program External communication regarding matters affecting internal control

controls.title: AI incident escalation path
controls.statement: AI-specific incidents (harmful or discriminatory output, data leakage through a model, vendor model failure, an agent taking an unintended action) have a defined path: disable the system, notify the AI owner and the accountable executive within one hour, assess legal duties, and communicate to affected customers.
controls.text: AI incident escalation path AI incident escalation path AI-specific incidents (harmful or discriminatory output, data leakage through a model, vendor model failure, an agent taking an unintended action) have a defined path: disable the system, notify the AI owner and the accountable executive within one hour, assess legal duties, and communicate to affected customers. If an AI system does something harmful, there is a set order of steps: switch it off, tell the right people fast, then work out who else must know. Texas HB 149 gives a 60-day cure period after Attorney General notice; the path is designed to finish containment well inside it. Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents Response to identified security incidents through an incident response program Procedures are followed to respond to and recover from a previously unknown risk when it is identified Incidents and errors are communicated to relevant AI actors, including affected communities Organizational practices are in place to enable AI testing, identification of incidents, and information sharing

controls.statement: Every incident and every production regression gets a written review with timeline, root cause, and actions, published internally within two weeks.
